entries.text: Genesis — opens the append-only R-CORE record for the shared moderator SETTINGS slide-over: a right-side drawer with the language selector, the session-cascading theme customizer (8 presets + custom), the cost-estimate table, AI + voice-to-text provider selectors, the Cube Architecture status, the Language Lexicon admin and the Atlantis Accords / Vision 2525 links. Auth-gated: polling users see it view-only, moderators get full control. Earliest reachable commit that touched it: ef8b1c3.
Create Doc and the POD session share one AI provider choice, made in Settings; the pod's summary now flows through the provider selected here.
Site-UX keyify batch 2 — 79 hardcoded strings across the Settings surface and its child components routed through t() for the 33-language lexicon.
Settings drops the Light Codex row — its one door is the easter-egg launcher, so the duplicate control is removed (Succinctness).

R-CORE version-history badge mounted inside the SETTINGS slide-over (Stage 2): it appears bottom-centre while Settings is open and, on two clicks, opens the R-CORE · Version History compare panel over this surface's own append-only ledger — so the evolution of Settings is itself traceable through the same compare tool as more features land (operator 2026-09-25).
